transcript.text: This is intake for Andre Williams, November 11th.

transcript.text: How old are you now?

transcript.speaker: Andre
transcript.text: I got out of Sheridan on the 2nd. I'm staying with my cousin in Englewood, on the couch. He said two weeks, maybe three.

transcript.speaker: Andre
transcript.text: I don't have any ID. Just the release papers.

transcript.speaker: Andre
transcript.text: My blood pressure pills ran out Saturday. They only gave me two weeks' worth.

transcript.speaker: Andre
transcript.text: I want to work. I did forklift in there, I got the certificate.

transcript.speaker: Andre
transcript.text: I'm not on food stamps or nothing.

transcript.speaker: Denise
transcript.text: What's the best number to reach you?

transcript.speaker: Andre
transcript.text: It's my cousin's phone, 773-555-01 [inaudible, 2 sec]

transcript.speaker: Denise
transcript.text: So this week we start your state ID, get your pills refilled, and I'll call you Friday.
